semantics.title: Fair launch
semantics.summary: As of the block named in the artifact, the observed state of the launch met policy fair-launch-v1: the contract was deployed, mint authority was renounced, the contract was not an upgradeable proxy, at least 25% of supply was burned to the dead address, the largest holder owned no more than 3%, there were at least 5 unique top holders, liquidity was burned or curve-managed, transfer tax was at most 1%, and creator allocation was at most 5%. The claim is about one token at one block. It is not a guarantee that the token cannot be rugged later, and it is not a statement about profit.
